experiences.location: San Diego County, California, United States
experiences.description:
NetSuite Assist by Dolapa is an AI-powered support deflection and governance platform built for NetSuite teams. We help organizations reduce repetitive support requests by surfacing answers before tickets are submitted, while protecting ERP data quality through structured intake checkpoints.

What we do

- Deflection-first support: search and guided answers before case submission
- Governance at intake: transaction context, required attachments, structured categorization, and root-cause capture
- Living knowledge base that improves with real support patterns
- Integrations that reduce double entry (including Jira sync)
- Built for hypercare and high-volume support periods

Dolapa exists to help teams scale NetSuite support without scaling headcount, and to create clean operational data that enables better reporting and future AI initiatives.

As a hands-on architect and developer, I design customized NetSuite solutions that solve complex client challenges. From advanced scripting and workflows to third-party integrations, I translate business needs into scalable, automated processes. My work reduces manual effort, improves reporting accuracy, and empowers leadership teams to make faster, data-driven decisions.

Serving in the Army Reserves taught me the importance of precision and readiness. I managed logistical and financial transactions for Army units using GCSS-Army, a SAP-based ERP system. By streamlining processes and improving data visibility, I ensured mission readiness, reduced delays, and supported operations with accuracy and accountability.

I joined Maersk during a period of major system expansion, tasked with supporting 500+ users across global subsidiaries. I drove adoption by providing training and technical support while implementing intercompany workflows and multi-currency reporting. My work reinforced compliance with SOX ITGC standards and strengthened financial reporting for $500M+ in assets.

When Performance Team migrated from MAS 500 to NetSuite, I played a leading role in managing the transition of $500M in annual revenue. I built custom reports, workflows, and automations that saved time and increased accuracy. By partnering with FP&A and operations leaders, I turned financial data into actionable insights across 13 business units.

I oversaw financial reporting and month-end close, ensuring compliance with GAAP standards while supporting audits for SOX controls. Beyond compliance, I collaborated with FP&A to provide analysis that informed key strategic decisions. This dual role allowed me to strengthen both the integrity of financial reporting and the value of insights delivered to leadership.
